theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_creg_jacobian_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] Eucl P) (D : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] Eucl (m + 1)) (γ : Eucl P), γ ∈ LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → (∀ y : Eucl (m + 1), inner ℝ γ (A (D y)) = y 0) → Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin m => inner ℝ (A (D (EuclideanSpace.single i.succ 1))) (A (D (EuclideanSpace.single j.succ 1)))).det = ‖γ‖ * Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (A (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (A (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det * |D.det|
